hypothesis: Delivery and reverse receipts depend on the sole authorized A-R-B Ethernet path and current fixture policies; no IP fallback or replacement message ID is used.

cases.stimulus: 10 distinct 128-byte requests on intact A-R-B; SHA-256 worker and reverse receipts
cases.oracle: 10 NEW deliveries and 10 matching COMPLETED; ACCEPTED and ERROR types also checked without downgrading COMPLETED
BCP length 1500, Ethernet length 1514 excluding FCS; exact decrypted bytes and matching result
PACKET_TOO_LARGE before return/TX; no oversized frame and no new outbox original

cases.stimulus: barrier: stop R, then issue 10 new IDs; do not count pre-barrier traffic
cases.oracle: 0 NEW deliveries and 0 COMPLETED for post-barrier IDs; UNKNOWN retained, at most 3 attempts and 20s to local bounded outcome

cases.stimulus: flip final byte of a known-valid hop signature, then send the intact frame with same sequence
cases.oracle: AUTH_FAILED for injected frame; intact frame still accepted, no replay-floor poisoning or automatic ERROR reply

cases.stimulus: same immutable request and ID/hash with a fresh allowed hop sequence
cases.oracle: DUPLICATE on B; one persisted delivery; no automatic second worker execution

cases.stimulus: publish fixture L with changed source epoch; inject authenticated packet still bound to older C
cases.oracle: KEY_REVOKED after node observes that L; no forward or delivery

cases.stimulus: withdraw forward transit, then separately withdraw reverse connection in fixture L
cases.oracle: POLICY_DENIED in each direction after L observed; no delivery on forbidden direction

cases.stimulus: controlled fixture-provider unavailable, then explicitly old (>1800s) header; no live RPC fallback
cases.oracle: STATE_UNAVAILABLE then STATE_STALE; no stale-cache acceptance, no fresh ID or frame returned

cases.stimulus: restart B after committed delivery and completed receipt; retain journal; retry before and after a new handshake
cases.oracle: AUTH_FAILED before handshake; after handshake DUPLICATE, one delivery/worker result retained

cases.stimulus: late ACCEPTED/ERROR and unknown-original receipt; separately conflict original ID/hash
cases.oracle: COMPLETED/result retained; UNKNOWN for missing original; MESSAGE_CONFLICT for conflicting original/result; no new original

cases.stimulus: controlled stop after DELIVER/NEW journal commit but before worker result commit
cases.oracle: UNKNOWN/needs-operator-reconciliation; no claim of COMPLETED/exactly-once and no automatic new ID or worker replay
